name: 百度地图
description_zh: 接入百度地图位置服务:地点检索与详情、路线规划(驾车/骑行/步行/公交)、批量算路、地址正逆解析、实时路况、天气查询、行政区划与地图调起;同时提供 BMapGL 前端与 WebAPI 服务端的开发指引。
description: Baidu Maps location services: place search, route planning, geocoding, live traffic and weather, plus BMapGL and WebAPI development guides.
description_en: Baidu Maps location services: place search, route planning, geocoding, live traffic and weather, plus BMapGL and WebAPI development guides.
examples_zh: 帮我规划从北京西站到故宫的驾车路线
西湖附近适合带孩子的餐厅有哪些
写一个 BMapGL 页面显示多个 Marker
examples_en: Plan a driving route from Beijing West Railway Station to the Forbidden City
Find family-friendly restaurants near West Lake
Write a BMapGL page that shows multiple markers
